title: Signature, Attempt and Holding Schedule — Online Orders Carriers
content:
Handover terms differ by Online Orders delivery service. The schedule fixes, per service, when an adult signature is required, how many delivery attempts the carrier makes, how long the carrier holds an undelivered parcel, and when a delivered order closes.

| Delivery service | Adult signature required at order total of (USD) | Delivery attempts | Carrier holding period (calendar days) | Order closes after delivery (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 750.00 or more | 1 | 15 | 90 |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 0.00 (every order) | 1 | 7 | 90 |
| Standard Ground | 750.00 or more | 3 | 5 | 90 |
| Expedited 2-Day | 750.00 or more | 3 | 5 | 90 |
| Next Business Day | 750.00 or more | 3 | 5 | 90 |
| Same-Day Courier | 0.00 (every order) | 1 | 0 | 90 |

## Column definitions

- **Adult signature threshold**: the order total at or above which an adult signature is required. A threshold of 0.00 means every order needs a signature or a pickup code.
- **Delivery attempts**: the attempts the carrier makes before holding the parcel.
- **Carrier holding period**: the calendar days the carrier holds a parcel for collection after the last attempt, or at the pickup point, before returning it to the sender.
- **Order closes after delivery**: the calendar days after the delivered date at which a delivered order closes.

## Threshold sides (750.00 services)

| Order total | Adult signature |
|---|---|
| 749.99 | Not required by the threshold |
| 750.00 | Required |
| 750.01 and above | Required |

## Notes on the schedule

- Pickup Point Delivery and Same-Day Courier sit at 0.00, so every one of their Online Orders parcels is handed over only against a signature or a pickup code, whatever the order total.
- Same-Day Courier carries a holding period of 0 days: a parcel the courier cannot deliver is not held for collection.
- Economy Ground makes a single attempt but has the longest holding period, 15 calendar days.
